title: Basic supplies
summary: Start with a small kit you can actually use and maintain.
steps: Plan water, food, lights, a radio, chargers, medicines, and hygiene items around your household's needs.
A common US planning baseline is at least three days of supplies; longer may be needed in some places or for specific needs.
Include children, pets, accessibility needs, and a plan for leaving home quickly.
Check dates, batteries, and your backup files regularly.
